newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine electricity output up 4.8 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Argentine electricity output up 4.8 pct in March.

text.p: Argentine electricity generation in March rose 4.8 percent on the same month last year because of increased public consumption and industrial activity, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.

The ministry's public service data for March also showed a 9.5 percent increase on February, as well as a 5.9 percent increase in electricity generation in the first quarter of this year compared to the first quarter of 1996.
A ministry statement said the March rise was "basically due to higher public consumption and an increase in the level of activity in the industrial sector."
